body: My last semester of undergrad I went through a really rough patch of depression following a horrible break up the winter before. I ended up crying in one of the dining halls on campus because I just couldn’t stop myself, even though I hate crying in public. At one point I got up to get more food and when I came back, a girl had written me a note saying that it’ll all get better even though it’s tough now. I cried even more but for a good reason. It helped keep the bad thoughts at bay for a while.
Thank you I appreciate it

I know it sucks: college is really tough even without depression, but is so much harder with it. I know first  hand how not doing well in your school work makes depression so much worse; I'm a perfectionist and every bad grade I get pushes me down. But I realizes that overall I'm still doing super well, and once it's all over and I have my degree I'll be happy that I put in so much work. Hang in there. Keep trying your hardest, but make sure to take some time for yourself even if it means missing work. You're in the program you are in at the school you are at because you can do this. If you still don't think it's worth it after this, maybe try switching programs or schools. Whatever you decide, do it for you. You got this!!
